questions.question: What is disk scheduling?
questions.answer: Disk scheduling is the process of determining the order in which disk I/O requests are serviced.

questions.question: What is Slow Start in TCP?
questions.answer: Slow Start is a TCP congestion control algorithm that increases the congestion window exponentially until a threshold is reached.

questions.question: What is a lock in DBMS?
questions.answer: A lock is a mechanism used to control concurrent access to data items.

questions.question: What is waiting time?
questions.answer: Waiting time is the total time a process spends waiting in the ready queue.

questions.question: What is a balanced binary tree?
questions.answer: A balanced binary tree is a tree in which the height difference between left and right subtrees is bounded.

questions.question: What is the difference between RANK() and DENSE_RANK()?
questions.answer: RANK() skips rank values after ties, whereas DENSE_RANK() assigns consecutive ranks.

questions.question: What is the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)?
questions.answer: The GIL is a mutex in CPython that allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time.

questions.question: What is Floyd-Warshall algorithm?
questions.answer: Floyd-Warshall is a dynamic programming algorithm used to find shortest paths between all pairs of vertices.

questions.question: What is System Design?
questions.answer: System Design is the process of defining the architecture, components, interfaces, and data flow of a software system to meet business and technical requirements.

questions.question: What is an object?
questions.answer: An object is an instance of a class that contains state (attributes) and behavior (methods).

questions.question: What is method injection?
questions.answer: Method injection provides dependencies directly as parameters to methods.

questions.question: What is a schema?
questions.answer: A schema is the logical structure of a database that defines tables, relationships, constraints, and other objects.
